review_status: Numerical and structural consistency checks passed; interpretation remains conditional on the stated assumptions and limitations.

checks.detail: The participant table and sample flow reproduce from the supplied CSVs with one matched row per ID.
The saved plan, input hashes, eligibility rules, fixed cutoff and group counts match the current data.
Both means, sample SDs, SEs, t degrees of freedom and 95% interval endpoints reproduce on the same paired-normal rows.
All 10,000 paired mean draws and their summaries reproduce with seed 314159.
The higher-minus-lower contrast, fixed group sizes, Welch statistic, df, raw p-value and interval reproduce.
All 10,000 stratified score differences and their summaries reproduce with seed 271828 and fixed group sizes.
All four group summaries, individual mean intervals, Welch ANOVA, diagnostics and descriptive eta-squared reproduce.
Exactly the two registered tests appear with current raw p-values, Holm adjustment and familywise decisions.
Independent inclusive quantiles and SD checks agree with retained draws; contrast signs, CI/test decisions, Holm monotonicity and the SS decomposition agree.
All five vector PDFs reproduce byte for byte with the shared grayscale palette.
Tracked inputs, analysis code, prior results and figures remained unchanged throughout the review.

mean_score.parameter: Population mean ANIMALS score under the paired_normal eligibility rules

mean_thickness.parameter: Population mean left inferior parietal cortical thickness under the paired_normal rules

within_normal_cognition.unit: Correct animal names in 60 seconds, higher MRI group minus lower MRI group
within_normal_cognition.interpretation: The registered grouped comparison gives insufficient evidence of a score difference at familywise alpha 0.05. Its intervals leave uncertainty about the size and direction of the contrast; practical equivalence has not been assessed.

across_cognitive_groups.interpretation: The model-based omnibus test supports a difference in at least one mean thickness across the four cognitive groups. It does not identify a specific pair. Eta-squared describes this sample's SS partition and is sensitive to group composition.

bootstrap_comparisons.interpretation: Standard and percentile procedures give similar uncertainty estimates conditional on these observed data. Resampling the same extract provides an internal comparison of methods; it is not an independent replication of the study.

interpretation_rules.different_questions: The score contrast compares MRI-defined groups within normal cognition; the omnibus test compares MRI means across UDS cognitive groups. They address different parameters in different eligibility samples.
interpretation_rules.confidence_intervals: Interpret the 95% intervals through repeated-sampling coverage under the model assumptions. Each interval concerns its stated population parameter in its original units; it is an individual interval.
interpretation_rules.p_values: Interpret raw and adjusted p-values under the null and method assumptions, alongside effect sizes and uncertainty. They do not measure the probability that a hypothesis is true or establish practical importance.
interpretation_rules.continuous_question: The primary Phase 4 parameter is the adjusted score difference per 0.1 mm of thickness. A binary MRI-group contrast is a different parameter and leaves that continuous association to be estimated.
interpretation_rules.observational_scope: All Phase 3 comparisons are exploratory and unadjusted. The supplied single-record participant data support association descriptions under the stated eligibility rules.

material_limitations.sampling_frame: The sampling frame and selection probabilities are undocumented. Confidence intervals depend on the sampling assumptions and the stated eligibility rules.
material_limitations.independence: Unique participant IDs establish one supplied record per person. Independence across people remains a modeling assumption; the review cannot validate the sampling design.
material_limitations.source_preparation: Preparation and imputation details and value-level masks are unavailable. Estimates and resampling condition on the supplied values; additional source-preparation uncertainty cannot be quantified from these files.
material_limitations.measurement_timing_and_qc: Clinical and MRI timing and scan-level QC details are unavailable. Numerical usability checks do not establish measurement quality or temporal alignment.
material_limitations.small_group: The impairment-without-MCI group has seven participants. Its mean interval and Welch approximation are sensitive to departures from normality and individual extreme values.
material_limitations.normality: The empirical skewness and Q-Q plots describe tail asymmetry. Welch does not remove sensitivity to non-normal observations in small groups; the test is a model-based exploratory comparison.
material_limitations.cutoff: The pooled Phase 2 median is held fixed. Inference is conditional on that cutoff and, for the stratified bootstrap, the observed group sizes.
material_limitations.covariates: Age, sex and education will be incorporated in Phase 4 on the common eligible modeling sample.
